title: Improving GPT‑5.6 Sol in ChatGPT—and expanding access to GPT-5.6 Luna for free users
author: Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: ChatGPT introduces improved GPT-5.6 Sol with better accuracy and consistency, plus expanded access for free users and unlimited everyday chats with GPT-5.6 Luna.
body:
## Enhanced Capabilities for ChatGPT
A significant update has been introduced to ChatGPT, featuring an improved version of GPT-5.6 Sol. This enhancement brings about increased accuracy and consistency in responses, elevating the overall user experience. The upgrade is designed to provide more reliable and precise interactions, making it a valuable asset for those engaging with the platform.

## Expanded Access and Unlimited Chats
In addition to the improved GPT-5.6 Sol, access to GPT-5.6 Luna has been expanded for free users. This expansion allows a broader audience to leverage the capabilities of GPT-5.6 Luna without incurring costs. Furthermore, users can now enjoy unlimited everyday chats with GPT-5.6 Luna, facilitating more extensive and in-depth conversations.

## Impact on Developers and Researchers
The introduction of improved GPT-5.6 Sol and expanded access to GPT-5.6 Luna is poised to have a significant impact on developers and researchers. By providing more accurate and consistent responses, the updated technology can aid in a wide range of applications, from content creation to data analysis. The increased accessibility of GPT-5.6 Luna also enables a broader range of users to explore and innovate with the technology, potentially leading to new breakthroughs and discoveries.
